about: Well-known commercial series and products for children that may not be downloaded freely. A search for one of them that finds nothing in the list shows an honest hint instead of an empty result (src/core/sources/commercial.ts). 'match' is compared on folded text (lower case, umlauts as ae/oe/ue, sharp s as ss), as whole words; '???' and '!!!' stay; the longest match wins. 'alone' only counts when the search is exactly that, so 'die drei' finds 'Die drei ???' but 'die drei kleinen Schweinchen' does not. A series with a source in sources/catalog.json (any status but 'off') must not be listed here: tests/sources/ranking.test.ts checks that.
